snippet.title: Mayfly | Solo indie psychological ‘quiet horror’ game | Trailer (Q3 2026)
snippet.description:
Mayfly is a short story-led ‘quiet horror’ set entirely on a narrowboat in northern England. 

Experience Caroline Miller's slow descent into a dark and twisted reality as she attempts to locate her missing husband

//----------------------------------------------//
Wishlist now on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4057470/Mayfly
//----------------------------------------------//

Mayfly is a debut solo development project from Backyard Zoo.

🤫A quiet horror, designed to be subtle and impose an ever-growing sense of unrest without relying on jump scares 

⏱️Designed to be completed in under an hour

🔎 Find clues and solve puzzles to guide Caroline on her way back to her husband Robert

⌨️Highly accessible with full keyboard navigation support in all menus

💾 Set in the late 90s in the North-West of England, packed with niche references, how many can you find?

👂 An eerie disturbing soundtrack with 3D sound design and professional voice acting 

📖 A deeply layered lore which can be explored at your own pace

//----------------------------------//
Launching on Steam in Q3 2026
//----------------------------------//
